text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — Samir (primary for the weekend) just DM'd me: family emergency, needs Sunday+Monday off. That leaves a coverage gap over the Easter bank holiday. Also, we have a production spike: increased 5xxs in EU since ~08:12 UTC — I opened PD-7894. Need someone to take primary for Sunday (00:00-23:59 UTC). Can someone volunteer? Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/hosting-api-502

Oncall Bot: PD-7894 created by monitoring. Trigger: 2026-04-05T08:12:23Z. Symptom: elevated 502/504s in prod-eu. Impact: ~2% of requests degraded; some customers see timeouts. Current scheduled primary: Samir Patel (acknowledged). Secondary: Lin Zhao (notified).

Lin Zhao: I'm currently listed as secondary but I'm actually on PTO until 16:00 UTC on Sunday. I can cover overnight 00:00-08:00 UTC if that helps, but can't do the full day. Happy to be temp-primary for the early window if someone picks up the rest.

Alex Rivera: I can take 08:00-23:59 UTC on Sunday. Need a handoff/bridge at ~07:50 UTC. Also please point me to the rollback/runbook snippet for model funnel rollback if errors cross 5%.

Maya Chen: Thanks — @Jon, can you be secondary for the full day? I'll update the rota. Bridge 07:50 UTC if volunteers confirmed.

Jon Bishop: I can be secondary. I'll take first-response for PD-7894 if it keeps alerting. Quick runbook pointer: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/hosting-api-502 — note: use 'clear-cache-eu' only after triage. Quick log check I use: ```kubectl logs -l app=hosted-api -n prod-eu --tail 200 | grep -i 502```

Samir Patel: Sorry team — family emergency. I've acknowledged PD and left a short playbook in the incident log: restarted 2 replicas, cleared local prefix cache, observed transient improvement then regression. I won't be online Sunday — really appreciate cover. Incident notes are in PD-7894.

Oncall Bot: PD-7894 severity escalated to SEV2 based on customer impact. Current assignees: Alex Rivera (primary starting 08:00 UTC), Jon Bishop (secondary). Alerts will continue to PD until resolved or suppressed. Bridge link will be posted.

Lin Zhao: If latency keeps rising we can reduce traffic via routing to dedicated fallback pool 'dedicated-fallback-eu'. Operator command (manual): ```rctl set-route --pool dedicated-fallback-eu --weight 30%``` Use only after compatibility check with model variants.

Alex Rivera: ACK. I'll join the bridge at 07:50 UTC. Customers with >20% error rate in the last 10m: corp-analytics, fintech-beta. Maya — can you prepare the customer-impact blurb for status and #customer-impact?

Maya Chen: Draft for status: "We are investigating elevated error rates in EU affecting some customers intermittently. Engineers are actively mitigating; ETA unknown. Updates every 30 minutes." I'll post to status.redwood and ping CSMs.

Jon Bishop: If we need to roll back the model push, runbook rollback command: ```redwood deploy rollback --model hosted-gpt --to v1.13 --region eu``` Note: rollback requires two approvers or PD primary can initiate in emergency.

Alex Rivera: Quick ops question — who can request temporary KMS access over the holiday? I may need key access to decrypt logs. @Maya?

Maya Chen: I can request but won't be at the bridge. If urgent, Jon, please open an infra ticket with template 'KMS-temp-access PD-7894' and tag infra-ops. I'll pre-fill justification in the ticket.

Lin Zhao: :thumbsup: I'll cover 00:00-08:00 UTC. Will hand off to Alex at ~07:50 on bridge. If anyone else can volunteer for Monday full-day (bank holiday) primary, please call out now.

Alex Rivera: :raised_hands: I'll take Sunday primary as planned and can extend into Monday morning until 08:00 UTC if nobody else steps up. Need a backup for Monday 08:00-20:00 UTC.

Jon Bishop: I can extend through Monday 12:00 UTC if needed. Let's avoid >2 handoffs in a row. I'll update the rota and incident notes.

Oncall Bot: Bridge scheduled: 2026-04-05T07:50:00Z join link https://zoom.company/bridge/7894 — incident channel #inc-PD-7894.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'll update the rotation calendar, post the customer blurb, and pin the runbook snippets to this thread. Final ask: whoever accepts primary, please confirm by 21:00 UTC today so we can populate calendar and PD overrides.

Alex Rivera: Confirmed. I'll update my calendar and PD schedule. Will post here after 21:00 UTC if anything changes.

Jon Bishop: I'll also add an entry to the incident with the cover plan and the step-by-step I ran earlier.

Maya Chen: Appreciate it. If PD keeps firing after midnight and no primary is on-call, escalate to oncall@redwood and we'll auto-notify the ops director.

Lin Zhao: Noted. I'll DM Alex my local notes before handoff. Good luck, team.

Alex Rivera: Thanks — see you on the bridge.
